title: Homework: data representation set B (10 questions)
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF data revision set B (10 questions) with self-marking.)
intro: Lesson 28 homework. Mark it yourself with the mark scheme. Use 1 KB = 1,024 bytes and 1 byte = 8 bits.

questions.q: Convert the hexadecimal number A7 to denary.

What is the range of numbers an 8-bit two's complement number can represent?
How many different characters can 7-bit ASCII represent?
